from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseDocument(BaseModel):
    """Represents one judicial document processed individually."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document (e.g., '《判决文书 1》')")
    identified_cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action identified in the document text")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cases: list[CaseDocument]
